targets.query:
from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk" and r._field == "used_percent" and r.path == "/" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk" and r._field == "used_percent" and (r.path == "/ingest-disk-buffer" or r.path =="/influx-data") and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "load5" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "n_cpus" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "mean_n_cpus"})
  |> yield(name: "mean_n_cpus")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r._field == "usage_idle" and r.cpu == "cpu-total" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: (r._value * -1.0) + 100.0 }))
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mem" and r._field == "used_percent" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r._field == "usage_iowait" and r.cpu == "cpu-total" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "processes" and r._field == "total" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "processes" and r._field == "total_threads" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "swap" and r._field == "used_percent" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mem" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "total", "used", "cached", "free", "buffered"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r.cpu == "cpu-total" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage_user" or r._field == "usage_system" or r._field == "usage_softirq" or r._field == "usage_steal" or r._field == "usage_nice" or r._field == "usage_irq" or r._field == "usage_iowait" or r._field == "usage_guest" or r._field == "usage_guest_nice")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "usage_user", "usage_system", "usage_softirq", "usage_steal", "usage_nice", "usage_irq", "usage_iowait", "usage_guest", "usage_guest_nice"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "load1" or r._field == "load5" or r._field == "load15")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "load1", "load5", "load15"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r._field == "usage_idle" and r.cpu =~ /cpu[0-9].*/ and r.host == "${host}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: 100.0 - r._value }))
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "processes" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "running" or r._field == "blocked" or r._field == "sleeping" or r._field == "stopped" or r._field == "zombies" or r._field == "paging" or r._field == "unknown")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kernel" and r._field == "context_switches" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> yield(name: "context switches")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk" and r.host == "${host}" and r.path == "/")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total" or r._field == "used" or r._field == "free")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.path == "/ingest-disk-buffer" or r.path =="/influx-data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total" or r._field == "used" or r._field == "free")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk" and r._field == "used_percent" and r.host == "${host}")
  |> group(columns: ["path", "device", "fstype"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> yield(name: "used_percent")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "disk" and r._field == "inodes_free" and r.host == "${host}")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")

from(bucket: "node_telemetry")

list.definition:
from(bucket: "node_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> keep(columns: ["host"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "host")
